agencies.name: ad-copy-crew
agencies.title: Ad Copy Crew
agencies.tagline: Turns a product and audience into scroll-stopping ad copy variants across distinct angles.

agencies.name: api-design-crew

agencies.name: bug-triage-crew

agencies.tagline: Finds, fixes, and re-tests failing code until the suite is green.
agencies.deliverable: A passing test suite on the target module

agencies.name: code-review-crew
agencies.title: Code Review Crew
agencies.tagline: Reviews a module for defects, fixes the issue, and explains the change.
agencies.deliverable: A reviewed, fixed module with the issue explained.

agencies.name: competitor-teardown-crew
agencies.title: Competitor Teardown Crew
agencies.tagline: Turns a rival product into a structured teardown you can act on.
agencies.deliverable: A structured competitor teardown: positioning, key features, pricing, and the gaps to exploit.

agencies.name: crazygames-quality-crew
agencies.title: CrazyGames Quality Crew
agencies.tagline: Audits a built HTML game against the published CrazyGames quality guidelines and returns a SHIP/BLOCK verdict before a human reviewer sees it.
agencies.deliverable: A crazygames-audit.md with a SHIP/BLOCK verdict, every finding quoted against the exact published criterion it violates, and the concrete fix.

agencies.name: data-analysis-crew
agencies.title: Data Analysis Crew
agencies.tagline: Examines small datasets and communicates evidence-based findings.
agencies.deliverable: A findings brief from the dataset.

agencies.name: deployable-html-verify-crew
agencies.title: Deployable HTML Verify Crew
agencies.tagline: The deployability gate that boot-smokes a self-contained HTML playable ad against the engines/web frozen contract and turns failures into concrete repairs.
agencies.deliverable: A recorded pass/fail verdict (verify.json) on build/<slug>/index.html plus, on failure, ordered repair instructions for the builder.

agencies.name: escalation-brief-crew
agencies.title: Escalation Brief Crew
agencies.tagline: Turns a stalled support thread into a crisp engineering escalation brief.
agencies.deliverable: An engineering escalation brief: summary, repro steps, customer impact, and the specific ask.

agencies.name: game-builder-crew
agencies.title: Game Builder Crew
agencies.tagline: Turns a game design into a complete, self-contained HTML playable-ad game for the freeform web genre.
agencies.deliverable: A self-contained build/<slug>/index.html playable-ad game (Canvas2D) that obeys the frozen self-contained-game contract.

agencies.name: game-goal-crew
agencies.title: Game Goal Crew
agencies.tagline: Turns a chosen concept into a validated freeform game design.json and a goal.md fun-promise contract.
agencies.deliverable: A schema-valid design.json (engines/web freeform input) plus a goal.md with a one-line fun promise and 3-5 acceptance criteria.

agencies.name: game-idea-crew
agencies.title: Game Idea Crew
agencies.tagline: Turns a theme or brief into three distinct freeform playable-ad game concepts across the launch, drop, and match mechanics.
agencies.deliverable: A concepts.md with three distinct playable-ad game concepts, each with a title, mechanic, hook, and why it fits a ~10-second ad.

agencies.name: game-meta-crew
agencies.title: Game Meta Crew
agencies.tagline: Writes the engines/web freeform catalog metadata and store blurb for a finished playable-ad game.
agencies.deliverable: A catalog-exact build/<slug>/_meta.toml (engines/web freeform format) plus a short, polished store blurb.

agencies.name: game-qa-crew
agencies.title: Game QA Crew
agencies.tagline: Playtest-reviews a built HTML playable-ad game for playability and quality, and returns a PASS/FAIL QA report with prioritized fixes.
agencies.deliverable: A qa-report.md with a PASS/FAIL verdict, severity-ranked findings mapped to acceptance criteria, and concrete fixes.

agencies.name: incident-postmortem-crew
agencies.title: Incident Postmortem Crew
agencies.tagline: Investigates incident timelines and writes blameless improvement plans.
agencies.deliverable: A blameless postmortem with root cause + action items.

agencies.deliverable: deliverables/brief.md

agencies.name: qa-automation-crew
agencies.title: QA Automation Crew

agencies.deliverable: A generated + run test suite for the module.

agencies.deliverable: deliverables/release_notes.md

agencies.name: sales-outreach-crew

agencies.tagline: Researches a lead and drafts thoughtful, personalized outreach.
agencies.deliverable: A personalized 3-touch outreach sequence.

agencies.name: seo-brief-crew
agencies.title: SEO Brief Crew
agencies.tagline: Shapes search-informed topics into focused content briefs.
agencies.deliverable: An SEO content brief (outline, keywords, angle).

records.subject: support-hq
records.benchmark: convention loop: declared-protocol memory vs no-memory control (headroom holdout)

cost.verdict: first memory-beats-control signal in this series; 2/6 vs 0/6 is not statistically resolved (Fisher p~0.45)

benchmarks.headline: No significant memory effect on quality or cost across three companies. Both the earlier “memory hurts” result and an initial “memory wins” reading were substring-rubric artifacts; these numbers use a corrected rubric and a control verified to retrieve zero guidelines.
